# SSG Weekly Brief · 20–26 October 2026
_Published Tue 27 Oct 2026, 08:58 SGT · covers Tue 20 – Mon 26 Oct · built from the PE Clients and AI & Tech feeds_

## The week in brief
- **Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO** (ticker ANT): the first frontier lab to list, with US$16.3bn of revenue and an US$80bn-plus loss in the first half of 2026 in the S-1. Every AI comp the team uses gets re-based on this float. [Reuters, 26 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQLVVZWVV6TXQtR3ZqaWZKZERKZ3J3VVpIZlNtUjVfRjdTS0tuVTlRQ0F0UzRhcW9Hd2hxR1BtNzF4UVBVYXBpTkc0Rmozb3pRekc2RVNnOVBYd19KUGZ5VE1UN29haXQ2M0w0Qk1QTm5INk5KRlhxLUR6Q3REWHR3OG9EYkpFMGJUUm5HMGFiX3pBLXhZMHV5Qkgwdlc0RTczMnhOc3Q4NFpORFE5SlRfRkVDOWdmZw?oc=5)

KKR and TPG are Jio holders. ## Live processes to get in front of (APAC)
- **Jio Platforms (KKR, TPG), India** — lists 28 Oct after a record book. Post-listing, both sponsors become sellers-in-waiting and the telecom-plus-platform comps for India reset. Ask the KKR and TPG teams what moves next in their India books. [Upstox, 26 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **GCash / Mynt (Warburg Pincus), Philippines** — listed on the PSE on 20 Oct in a record IPO, with Warburg among the partial sellers; the stored roster has MoMo (Vietnam) as Warburg's next fintech exit, with Blackstone, CVC and MUFG bidding. [Marketing-Interactive, 21 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPUllaOWxDWGh2T0hPcGdXWElvMlZnaWtISlRHM3dJLWg0NnBBYWsxVUw4SG92cDRISXNSa3ZwaUxRRFRUYzh4VHRZeW9OVzNFZjBLTGhQTElUdUFBN1ZBcjJfc0h0dkYtR1pzLTduaTUyUWFzWHYyM0ltRURGTFdlTjVlbUtEblF4Ml8wYTJZdXlrU3NYcW8zeWpJVFJRUDhkZGhMZFpB?oc=5)
- **One Aged Care (TPG), Singapore** — bought home-care provider Active Global (Singapore and Hong Kong). An integration plan on rostering, care records and billing is the open question, and the add-on will not be the last. [DealStreetAsia, 26 Oct](https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/tpg-backed-one-aged-care-acquires-active-global-499132)
- **Ingenia (Warburg Pincus), Australia** — exclusivity granted on 20 Oct, lost by the 26th: Ingenia pulled Warburg from the data room after AVID's A$3.2bn offer. A reminder of how fast contested Australian take-privates move, and that a buy-side DD team can be stood down in a week. - **India IPO pipeline beyond Jio** — SCHOTT Poonawalla (TPG Growth) started work on a US$400m IPO and TA-backed OmniActive is exploring a US$200–300m listing at a US$1bn valuation; neither is a software asset, but both say the window is open for the roster's software names (Credila, Indira IVF, Virtusa, InCred, Avanse, Perfios, Whatfix). ## Platform shifts that change what a target is worth
- **Half-price frontier models**: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra ships with 3x faster agents at 50% lower pricing. The cost floor under every AI-native application just dropped again; re-run the gross-margin and pricing assumptions on any AI-application target under review. [BleepingComputer, 26 Oct](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- **Always-on agents**: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a background personal agent, and Walmart opened tools for agents to shop for customers; agent-mediated demand is a question for every consumer-internet and marketplace target. [Business Insider, 21 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxPQkZFNGVZc2Q2Q3VJYWVFNjFlOUh1NE1aNWFrZHlzOFlEMVpQU0xFQkFDSW4ydXljV1gtRnBBVzZjWi11Z3dMQ0sxdl9EdXdJOWl0TWlYMnl1M1o5S3d4LXRuOW9lLUd3bS1lYkloUnFGVnhqbFNJSGtVRUt4ZnlWSVg1Q01YOHlrWF9tZ0RsQXptUjljR0MxVFVaWW0xTXMweUE?oc=5)
- **Incumbents bundle agents into the suite**: Oracle launched 25 agentic applications across Fusion Cloud with no price attached and committed US$1bn to partners. Vertical SaaS targets that sell workflow on top of ERP lose pricing power as the platform absorbs it. [Kalkine, 26 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPV3NsUk1KTnlIZ3ZUeEgtV1p0NTlWZ3dHaEh4My1TODlqQ25zQ3FPNUx3dVN2LXNXTkswWTBRVkpackxKZEhnUElvOFZRWmxGRW9RRGcwN3BXZ2xDNFRaa0ZZcXlPS3RZR3lsd0F4aGJvc250a1U3SEFjQnhXOW1OTEQ1aW93eFNkWldDOEkzVkdEQ0dkcW9weDVBZ1lYMWljbWJiVXZJbzgyRi1xbWV0bTJXNmp5T1UzSC1tdlY4X3g?oc=5) · [Yahoo Finance, 24 Oct](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQM09zNzROQXNCOHRjMkNWb0NNWWNTUkgtb3ppZkhYYk5JZXI1SUk3Q0NHMmZkVDQ3UnkwUVR4SnNudkYxUEJjYWJmM3llUFNjOHYwOGdPeUJnOFpVTGFQb1NHbkxoSWdXd3lTdnFGb251N0lRY3ExVnhuTUlfMk9qNzJGRENkd1JGOGtkbTBQUWxXRDRveEkxUQ?oc=5)
